summary: This week's AI news highlights significant advancements in LLMs, cybersecurity, and AI applications. OpenAI's ChatGPT and Google's Gemini have both surpassed 1 billion users, while NVIDIA is expanding its AI infrastructure and Anthropic is making progress on unsolved math problems.
insight: The increasing adoption of AI models like ChatGPT and Gemini is driving innovation in various industries, from healthcare to finance, and raising important questions about the role of AI in society.
highlights: OpenAI's ChatGPT and Google's Gemini have both reached 1 billion users, marking a significant milestone in AI adoption.
NVIDIA is expanding its AI infrastructure and partnering with major companies to mobilize over $500 billion in investments.
Anthropic's models have made progress on the Riemann hypothesis, one of the most famous unsolved problems in mathematics.
